title: feat(console): the docs portal draws in an app-less variant of the app shell from 768 px up
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYnagJvGbCtNg2PhvgW

Fixes #37197
Part of #37150 — this PR carries its last open item (item 2, the standalone `/docs` portal's frame, ruled B in #37150 comment 7151721568); items 1, 3 and 4 landed in #37193.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 电脑上打开独立文档门户（文档首页、书、文章）时，顶栏没有了，左侧是和应用页面同样的侧栏：顶部是中性的「文档」入口（点开是你的应用列表和「添加应用」），正文是按应用分组的全部文档目录，「全部文档」排第一行；应用内文档的侧栏也把「全部文档」挪到了「返回应用」下面、目录之上的第一行；手机不变。
- 属于「去掉顶栏和平台首页那一层」专题，是「文档页进应用外壳」那张卡的最后一项：两个文档入口从此是同一种外观，按你批准的设计图做的。
- 出错时电脑上的文档门户会少了目录或入口，打开门户不会改动「上次使用的应用」；改动只在前端，直接撤回这个改动即可恢复原样。
- 无。

## What changes

From 768 px up, `/docs…` now renders in an app-less variant of the app shell, as designed in stage 1 and approved on #37197 (comment 7153085446, the maintainer: 「5 处都按建议，批准设计」).

- **New `DocsPortalShell`** (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/docs/`, exported from `@object-ui/app-shell`): on a phone it is `HomeLayout variant="docs"`, unchanged; from 768 px up it mounts the real `AppShell` with `showHeader={false}`, `UnifiedSidebar` in a new `docsPortal` mode, the docs-navigation slot from #37193, the page header's group and expand button (`ShellPageActionsScope sidebarExpand appless`), Home's AI drawer and Home's command palette (`HomeCommandPalette`, now exported from `HomeLayout`). Like `ConsoleLayout`, it draws a non-shrinking box at the top of the content holding `ChromeBannerHost` and `ConnectionBanner`, so the standing banners (impersonation, read rate, storage) and a lost-connection notice sit beside the fixed sidebar instead of over its head (seat L1 S2). The connection state comes from the data adapter, as `AppContent` reads it. It sets the navigation context to `home`, as Home's frame does, and never sets the current app, remembers a last app or applies an app's branding.
- **`UnifiedSidebar` `docsPortal`** (+ `docsPortalSearch`): the shell head and foot as in an app, a neutral 「Documentation」 head (`SidebarDocsPortalMenu`) instead of the app's name menu, and the docs-navigation target as the body. The search field is drawn only when a palette is mounted (Home's palette needs a host app).
- **`SidebarDocsPortalMenu`** (in `SidebarAppMenu.tsx`): the app menu's list, extracted into `AppMenuList` and shared by both menus, under 「Your apps」, with no row checked and no app-scoped row (「Design layout」, 「Edit app」), plus 「Add app」 for the viewers who may build. Choosing an app opens `/apps/APP`.
- **`ShellPageActionsScope appless`**: the page header's group without an app: the assistant, and `HelpMenu inApp={false}` with no app package. Without it the group resolves the app from the navigation context or the URL's second segment, which on the portal would be the last app or a book slug.
- **`PortalDocsNav`** (console `DocsNav.tsx`): every book the portal's index lists, under its app's heading, in the index's order (`groupBooksByApp`, the index's own grouping). Each book is named by its index card's label, so an implicit platform book reads as its app does (「系统设置」), not as its package id's last segment (「Setup」). `DocShell` and `DocPage` hand it to the sidebar on `/docs…`.
- **「All documentation」 the first docs row in both docs sidebars** (seat ruling on #37241: the back link is shell navigation, not a docs row): whenever the column is in the shell sidebar, `DocsNav` draws it as the first docs entry, marked current on the portal index. In an app's docs reader and in `AppDocsNav` it sits directly under 「← Back to APP」 and above the filter and the books; on the portal, which has no back link, it is the column's first row. The phone guard is the slot itself: a phone mounts no docs sidebar, so the column the page draws keeps the link at its foot, unchanged.
- **DELIBERATE CORRECTION** of #37193's pending changeset `.changeset/37150-docs-pages-in-app-shell.md` (seat ruling on #37241). One sentence. It was "The `/docs` portal is not changed by this release." and now reads "The `/docs` portal draws in the same frame from 768 px up too, in a variant that belongs to no app (its own entry describes it)." `check-empty-changeset` is red on this by design; the dispatching seat's record confirms it.
- `content/docs/frontend/app-shell.mdx`: the stale line "the app bar … on an app's docs pages, which mount no sidebar" is corrected. An app's docs pages draw the shell from 768 px up, and the portal draws the same frame with a neutral head.
- `App.tsx`: `DocsPortalRoute` mounts `DocsPortalShell` in place of `DefaultHomeLayout variant="docs"`. No route, redirect or URL changes.

Files to read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/docs/DocsPortalShell.tsx`: the variant switch, and what it does not write.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/UnifiedSidebar.tsx`: the `docsPortal` hunks (`shellChrome`, the head, the body condition, `hasCommandPalette`).
3. `ui/apps/console/src/pages/DocsNav.tsx`: `inSidebar` (the first-row move and its phone guard), and `PortalDocsNav`'s labels.

## Tests

- New `DocsPortalShell-37197.test.tsx`: real `DocsPortalShell`, `AppShell`, `ShellPageActionsScope`, docs slot and `NavigationProvider`.
  - `/docs`, `/docs/crm` and `/docs/crm/crm_intro` at 768 and 1440 px: no `header` element, the sidebar in `docsPortal` mode with no `activeAppName`, the page's tree drawn in the sidebar. PHONE CONTROL for each path at 390 px: Home's docs frame, no sidebar.
  - No app guessed: opened cold (1440 and 390), the context is `home`, no current app, and no last-app key is in storage; that storage check carries the pin. The `rememberApp` spy is only a tripwire for a future frame that would remember an app. After an app was open, on a package-named path, the head names no app, the help menu gets `inApp=false` and no package, and the current app stays as it was.
  - The app-less group, and the collapsed expand button in the docs header with no corner fallback; phone control.
  - Design point 5, the default accent (seat L1 S1): after an app whose `branding.primaryColor` was open, with `--primary`/`--accent` left on the root, the portal's root carries neither. Phone control.
  - The banners (seat L1 S2): at 1440 px a standing banner mounted above the routes (as `ConsoleShell` does) is drawn exactly once, inside the portal's banner box at the top of the content. A disconnected adapter shows the connection notice in that box; a connected one shows none. PHONE CONTROL: the banner stays where the shell mounts it, drawn once, with no box and no notice.
- `docs-portal.test.tsx`, new block `objectstack#37197`: the portal tree in the shell (first row, `aria-current` on the index, sections in the index's order, no back link, no in-page column). A book open in the tree with the article current. The label fix (an app labelled `System settings`, so not 「Setup」). Every portal URL form in the shell: index, SLUG, book NAME, NAME/DOC, doc-name-is-also-a-book-name, canonical SLUG/DOC, implicit package book, slug-that-is-another-book's-name. In an app's reader and docs index, 「All documentation」 is the first docs row: the back link stays the column's top row, and 「All documentation」 precedes the filter and the first book. PHONE CONTROL: the in-page column of the portal and of an app keeps it last.
- `SidebarAppMenu-36112`, new block: the portal head reads 「Documentation」, lists the apps under 「Your apps」 with none checked, opens any app by its address, gives 「Add app」 to an admin who may author and no app-scoped row; member control.
- `UnifiedSidebar.footerSlot-36739`, new block: in Home's context with a remembered app, `docsPortal` draws the portal head (not the app's), the page's tree as the body and the account foot; no search field without a palette; control without `docsPortal`.
- **#37193's N1**, in `ConsoleLayout.noTopBar-36112`: a docs route with `connectionState: 'disconnected'` shows `ConnectionBanner` in the banners box at 1440 px. A collapsed docs route draws the expand button in the docs header (a `DocShell` stand-in that reads the shell's expand slot) and no corner fallback. Each has a phone control.

Ablations, each via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor 1 to 0 on disk, restored blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The tests import `src`, so there is no `dist` leg.
1. The variant switch, `DocsPortalShell` `if (phone) {` changed to `if (phone || true) {`: `Tests 7 failed | 4 passed (11)`. Every desktop pin went red; the four phone controls stayed green.
2. The first-row switch, `DocsNav` `inSidebar` forced false: `Tests 4 failed | 76 passed (80)`. The two portal-tree tests and the two app-sidebar tests went red; the PHONE CONTROL stayed green. Re-run after the reorder, at `2961b4a9`: the same 4 red, PHONE CONTROL green, restored blob == HEAD.
3. The label fix, `{ ...resolved, label: card.label }` changed to `resolved`: the label test went red (`1 failed`).
4. The app-less group, `appless` removed from the scope: the no-guessed-app help test went red (`1 failed | 10 passed`).
5. S1, `AppShell` handed the host app's `branding` (anchor `navbar={null}` replaced): `Tests 1 failed | 15 passed (16)`, the default-accent pin red, its phone control green. A first attempt put the anchor inside its own replacement; the tool refused it ("a drop of 0") and restored the file, so it measured nothing and was re-run.
6. S2, `ChromeBannerHost` deleted: `1 failed | 15 passed (16)`, the 1440 banner pin red. `ConnectionBanner` deleted: `1 failed | 15 passed (16)`, the notice pin red. The PHONE CONTROL stayed green in both.

Local runs. Each ran under `os-verify-lock` with `--maxWorkers=2`; every one reports `VERDICT command-exit 0` unless it says otherwise.

## Acceptance notes

- **N2 and the stage-2 views** are real renders against the showcase example on a fresh database: zh-CN browser locale, `deviceScaleFactor` 2, this branch's Console on Vite. They were committed at `672b06dd` and removed in the next commit, so the PR's file list carries no binaries:

The page's one `header` element is the index's own title block, not a bar.

Re-captured too.
  - No last-app key was found in the browser's storage after any desktop view (measured on each).
- Home's command palette keeps its scope: the host app it searches is read the way Home reads it, as the portal's old frame did, and is never written back. That is search scope, not a frame app: the sidebar head, branding and help name no app.
- The portal's desktop sidebar carries the host's footer slot (the administrator's 「开始使用」 checklist in the screenshots), as every shell sidebar does.
- Book labels in an **app's** docs column (`usePackageDocsNavBooks`) still read the book's own label. For an implicit book of an app's own package that is the humanized package id. The approved scope was the portal tree, so this is noted, not changed.
- `overlap-check` reports exit 1 against #35129, the bot-maintained Version Packages PR (`chore: version packages`). That PR deletes every pending changeset, so the DELIBERATE CORRECTION above meets it as a modify/delete conflict on `.changeset/37150-docs-pages-in-app-shell.md`.
